title: Appointment booking and billing software for salons and spas
desc: A salon calendar by stylist, online booking, GST billing, memberships and packages, client history and WhatsApp campaigns. A concept build.
tag: Booking and billing for salons and spas
h1: Fill the chairs. Keep the regulars coming back.
lead: A calendar by stylist, an online booking page that respects who is free, quick GST billing, memberships and the messages that bring lapsed clients back.
heroAlt: SalonDesk calendar with bookings by stylist
fH2: What a busy salon needs at 6 pm on a Saturday
features: See every chair at once. Tap an empty slot to book, tap a booking to confirm, start, reschedule or bill it.
Booking that knows who is free
Clients pick services, a stylist and a time. Slots respect each person's skills, lunch break, weekly off and existing bookings.
Add services and retail products, apply a discount, take a tip and split the payment. The invoice prints with CGST and SGST.
Sell a wallet or a pack of facials. The wallet and the sessions left are used up at checkout, automatically.
Every client has visits, spend, notes and allergies. The team sees them before the service starts.
Lapsed clients, birthdays this month, low wallets and new clients, each with a ready WhatsApp message.
splits: One screen for the whole floor
Columns for each stylist, a lunch block, a live time marker and bookings coloured by person.
Walk-in button finds the next free chair
Know every client before they sit down
Visit count, spend, last visit, wallet and notes in one list. Filter by VIP, members or lapsed.
See what earns and who is busy
Revenue by day and category, stylist performance with commission, no-show rate and a heat map of the busiest hours.
steps: Enter prices, durations and which stylist does what. Set weekly offs.
Put it on Instagram and Google. Online bookings land in the calendar.
Check out in seconds, then send the lapsed-client message once a week.
pH2: A plan for one salon, not a chain
faq: Can clients book online without calling?
Yes. The booking page shows only the slots that are actually free for the chosen services and stylist.
Yes. A pack of six facials sits on the client's profile and is used up one session at a time at checkout.
Each stylist has a percentage. The team page shows revenue for the month before GST and tips, and the commission owed.
No. Clients and bookings are generated for a made-up salon and stay in your browser.
ctaH: Book a client, then bill them.
ctaP: Tap a free slot, add a service, check out and print the invoice.
